rules.topic: Enchanting power: 15 bookshelves give maximum power on both infusers (config maximumBookshelves); with Apotheosis installed the required count is fixed at 50 and modded shelves counting more than 1 power each apply

Cost model: prices are scaled so that applying every possible enchantment at maximum level to one item costs about maximumCost XP levels in total — 30 levels for the normal infuser, 20 for the advanced infuser; individual enchantment prices are shares of that budget weighted by rarity and level, so single enchantments are far cheaper than the cap
Per-level cost weights by enchantment rarity (config defaults): common 2, uncommon 3, rare 4, very rare 5; a level of a very rare enchantment weighs 2.5x a level of a common one in the scaled price
Enchantments normally unobtainable from an enchanting table (treasure class, e.g. mending) cost double when they are enabled (config doubleUniques, default true)

Availability thresholds as fractions of maximum bookshelf power (config defaults): common from 0 (offset -0.2), uncommon 0.2, rare 0.4, very rare 0.6; an enchantment reaches its maximum level at its threshold + 0.4 (rarityRange), so with 15 shelves a rare enchantment appears at 6 shelves and maxes at 12 shelves

Treasure enchantments additionally require 95% of maximum power (15 shelves: effectively full power) AND the types config allowTreasureEnchantments, which defaults to false on both infusers — mending is NOT obtainable from an infuser under default config

Advanced infuser overrides (constructor, lines 20-24): enchanting books allowed, modifying enchantments on already-enchanted items allowed (ALL), maximumCost lowered to 20 levels, anvil-only enchantments allowed, repairing tools and armor allowed
Normal infuser limits (defaults): only unenchanted items can be worked (existing enchantments cannot be raised or removed), books cannot be enchanted, and repairing is disabled entirely

Repair (advanced infuser): each repair step restores 25% of total durability and costs levels at a multiplier of 2.0 rounded up (repairStepMultiplier, same config class); a full repair from near-broken takes 4 steps

Working an item in an infuser does NOT raise its anvil prior-work penalty by default (config increaseAnvilRepairCost = false), so infuser enchanting and later anvil work do not punish each other unless the server enables it

Payment is player XP levels only: the menu checks experienceLevel against the computed cost; there is no lapis lazuli input or consumption anywhere in the infuser menu or cost configuration, unlike the vanilla enchanting table
